title: heracleum sphondylium f. latifolium
intro: Heracleum sphondylium f. latifolium, commonly known as wild angelica or broad-leaved angelica, is a biennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Heracleum sphondylium f. latifolium include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and diaphoretic effects, which can help to relieve muscle spasms, clear mucus from the lungs, and induce sweating. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
